subtitle: Cross-reading for 21/Sep/2026: Polymarket in the reading confirmed on 21/Sep, 17:01 BRT, plus the two national polls released that day, BTG/Nexus (fieldwork 18 to 20/Sep) and Palver (fieldwork 15 to 20/Sep), which closed fieldwork on the SAME day and measure opposite signs, and the press flow of 21/Sep.

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: PRICE: 38.50% (USD 11.66M cumulative volume) in the winner contract, down 3.00pp, in the reading confirmed on 21/Sep, 17:01 BRT, against the 00:06 BRT reading the same day. In the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second-place contract he falls 0.15pp, to 29.40% (USD 0.88M). POLL: 40% in the first round and 46% in the second in BTG/Nexus of 21/Sep, ahead in both; 41% and 43% in Palver the same day, behind in both.
fortes: Leads both rounds in BTG/Nexus released on 21/Sep, registration BR-00485/2026, 2,006 voters by phone between 18 and 20/Sep and a 2.0pp margin: 40% to 37% in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) and 46% to 45% in the second, both distances within two margins.

The day's two national polls closed fieldwork on the SAME 20/Sep, so the difference between them is not in the window: BTG/Nexus is by phone with a probability sample of 2,006 and Palver is online through social media ads, with a non-probability sample of 5,000 adjusted by quotas and weights.
His contract in the winner book has USD 11.66M cumulative, the largest between the two names disputing the price, in the reading confirmed on 21/Sep, 17:01 BRT.
fracos: Loses both rounds in Palver (registration BR-00860/2026, 5,000 voters online between 15 and 20/Sep, 2.8pp margin), released the same 21/Sep: 41% to 42% in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) and 43% to 47% in the second. The firm declares a [statistical tie](/en/glossary#empate-tecnico) in both.

In the winner contract he stands at 38.50% against 60.90% for Flávio Bolsonaro, a gap of 22.40pp, in the reading confirmed on 21/Sep, 17:01 BRT. In the readings recorded today that gap reached 23.80pp at 15:00 BRT, the widest of the 158 days in which the series has both sides.
In the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second-place contract he gives up 0.15pp, to 29.40%, against 68.50% for Flávio Bolsonaro in the same book.

In Palver he scores 43% in all FIVE second-round pairings tested, against Flávio Bolsonaro, Romeu Zema, Ronaldo Caiado, Augusto Cury and Renan Santos, and loses three of them. His number does not move with the opponent: all the variation is on the other side.
candidates.analise: Lula fell 3.00pp in the winner contract, from 41.50% to 38.50% (USD 11.66M cumulative volume), in the reading confirmed on 21/Sep, 17:01 BRT, against the reading confirmed on 21/Sep at 00:06 BRT. ⚠️ It is not the floor of his series, which is 34.50%, from 25 April. In the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second-place contract he gives up 0.15pp, to 29.40% (USD 0.88M). In the polls the day is one of disagreement between two firms that closed fieldwork on the SAME 20/Sep: BTG/Nexus puts him ahead in both rounds and he wins or ties the five pairings it tested, and Palver puts him behind in the main pairing and leaves him at 43% in its five pairings, losing three. AFOS does not say which of the two better describes the electorate. It says they diverge in sign, not only in magnitude, and that what separates them is the method, not the fieldwork window.

candidates.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
candidates.header: PRICE: 60.90% (USD 11.37M cumulative volume) in the winner contract, up 1.85pp, in the reading confirmed on 21/Sep, 17:01 BRT, against the 00:06 BRT reading the same day. In the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second-place contract he falls 2.00pp, to 68.50% (USD 1.05M). POLL: 42% in the first round and 47% in the second in Palver of 21/Sep, ahead in both; 37% and 45% in BTG/Nexus the same day, behind in both.
fortes: 60.90% in the winner contract, with USD 11.37M cumulative, in the reading confirmed on 21/Sep, 17:01 BRT, against 38.50% for Lula in the same book, a gap of 22.40pp.

Leads both rounds in Palver (registration BR-00860/2026, 5,000 voters online between 15 and 20/Sep, 2.8pp margin): 42% to 41% in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) and 47% to 43% in the second, and he is the only one of the five opponents tested who opens four points on Lula at that firm.

In the readings recorded today his gap over Lula reached 23.80pp at 15:00 BRT, the widest of the 158 days of the series opened on 14 April 2026. The certified reading of 17:01 BRT puts that gap at 22.40pp.
fracos: Loses both rounds in BTG/Nexus (registration BR-00485/2026, 2,006 voters by phone between 18 and 20/Sep, 2.0pp margin): 37% to 40% in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) and 45% to 46% in the second. At that firm he has the tightest of the five pairings tested against Lula.

In the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second-place contract he falls 2.00pp, to 68.50%, against the reading confirmed on 21/Sep at 00:06 BRT, and it was the only one of the two presidential books in which he gave ground on the day.

The volume of his contract in the winner book, USD 11.37M cumulative, is smaller than Lula's, at USD 11.66M, than Renan Santos's, at USD 13.99M, and than Tarcísio de Freitas's, at USD 14.08M, which is the largest in the book. High volume measures cumulative interest since opening, not probability now.
candidates.analise: Flávio Bolsonaro rose 1.85pp in the winner contract, from 59.05% to 60.90% (USD 11.37M cumulative volume), in the reading confirmed on 21/Sep, 17:01 BRT. In the readings recorded during the day his gap over Lula reached 23.80pp at 15:00 BRT, the widest of the 158 days of the series opened on 14 April 2026, and the certified reading puts that gap at 22.40pp. In the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second-place contract he gives up 2.00pp, to 68.50% (USD 1.05M). In the day's two national polls he appears ahead in Palver in both rounds and behind in BTG/Nexus in both, always within the declared margins. On 21/Sep the Official Gazette of the Union carried the dismissal of Eduardo Bolsonaro from his post as a [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) clerk for job abandonment. The proceeding is not from that day: the Federal Police concluded the administrative process in July and the minister signed the order on 18/Sep. The panel does not claim the act moved any price.

candidates.name: Augusto Cury
candidates.header: PRICE: 0.05% in the winner contract and 40.25% (USD 0.25M cumulative volume) in the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third-place contract, up 7.70pp in the reading confirmed on 21/Sep, 17:01 BRT. POLL: 6% in the first round in BTG/Nexus of 21/Sep, in third place, and 2% in Palver the same day, fourth.
fortes: Rises 7.70pp in the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third-place contract, to 40.25% (USD 0.25M cumulative volume), the largest rise of any contract on the panel this round, against the reading confirmed on 21/Sep at 00:06 BRT.
The distance to Renan Santos in that book shrank from 19.95pp to 5.25pp in a little over sixteen hours, and the price began moving in the direction the polls have been measuring.
He is third in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) of BTG/Nexus of 21/Sep, with 6%, and at that firm his second-round pairing against Lula is the second tightest, 43% to 44%.
fracos: In the winner contract he stays at 0.05%, in the reading confirmed on 21/Sep, 17:01 BRT, with USD 5.00M cumulative.

In Palver the same day he appears FOURTH, with 2%, behind Renan Santos, who has 11%, and loses the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) to Lula 35% to 43%. The day's two national polls disagree on the order of the third way as much as on the top of the race.
Today's move is not a series extreme: in the backup he has been at 60.30% in this same contract, on 04/Sep. What the round measures is the size of the shift, not a record level.
candidates.analise: Augusto Cury rose 7.70pp in the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third-place contract, from 32.55% to 40.25% (USD 0.25M cumulative volume), in the reading confirmed on 21/Sep, 17:01 BRT, against the reading confirmed on 21/Sep at 00:06 BRT. It was the largest rise among the contracts that received a new price this round, and on the other side of the same book Renan Santos fell 7.00pp, with the distance between the two shrinking from 19.95pp to 5.25pp. The day's two national polls do not agree on which of the two leads the third way: BTG/Nexus puts him third with 6% against 3% for Renan Santos, and Palver puts Renan Santos third with 11% against 2% for him. The panel records the book's movement and the disagreement between the firms, without asserting that one explains the other.

caiado.label: CAIADO (PSD), 0.05% in the WINNER contract, reading confirmed on 21/Sep, 17:01 BRT, below the 0.5% floor of the double reading, with USD 7.65M cumulative. haddad.label: HADDAD (PT), 0.05% in the WINNER contract, reading confirmed on 21/Sep, 17:01 BRT, at the book's floor. He is not a presidential candidate: he is running for the government of São Paulo, and the two national polls of 21/Sep do not test him in a presidential scenario.
haddad.fortes: His contract did not move in this reading, so there is no movement to explain, and the top of his series in the winner contract is 7.60%, on 26/May, measured in the database backup.
haddad.fracos: He is not measured in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) by the two national polls of 21/Sep nor tested in a second-round pairing, so the comparison between price and poll does not exist for him this round. zema.fortes: He remains at 0.15% in the winner contract, above the floor of his series, 0.10% on 17/Sep, even though the value stays below the 0.5% cut the panel uses to treat a thin price as noise.
zema.fracos: Falls 0.55pp in the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third-place contract, to 0.50%, and has 1% in the first round in both national polls of the day. cruzamento: The day had two movements and they run in different directions. In the winner contract the gap widened from 17.55pp to 22.40pp between the 00:06 reading and the 17:01 one, with Flávio Bolsonaro rising 1.85pp and Lula giving up 3.00pp. In the readings recorded during the day the gap reached 23.80pp at 15:00 BRT and Flávio's price reached 61.70% at 14:30, the two highest of the 158 days of the series opened on 14 April 2026; the certified reading is below both, and Lula, at 38.50%, is not at his floor, which is 34.50% and dates from 25 April. In the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third-place book Augusto Cury rose 7.70pp and Renan Santos fell 7.00pp, and the distance between them shrank from 19.95pp to 5.25pp. ⚠️ There no price is an extreme: in the backup, Cury has been at 60.30% in this same contract on 04/Sep. And the two national polls released that day resolve neither reading, because they disagree with each other: BTG/Nexus puts Lula ahead in both rounds and puts Augusto Cury third with 6% against 3% for Renan Santos; Palver puts Flávio Bolsonaro ahead in both and puts Renan Santos third with 11% against 2% for Cury. Both declare a [statistical tie](/en/glossary#empate-tecnico) in the main pairing and both closed fieldwork on the SAME 20/Sep, so what separates them is not the window, it is the method: phone with a probability sample of 2,006 against online non-probability through social media ads, with 5,000 and adjustment by quotas and weights. 📌 And there is a signature that appears only when looking at each firm's five second-round pairings: in Palver, Lula scores 43% against ALL five opponents, and all the variation stays on the other side; in BTG/Nexus he ranges from 44% to 47% depending on whom he faces.
